reviews.title: Killer Case for 11 fans! All white minimalist look!
reviews.comment: GPU will sit lower to the bottom intake fans. Make sure you have 90 degree gpu power connector to route above your GPU. Side mounting my 420mm would not fit. Definitely top mount the 420mm if you can. Overall case is great! Watch out when you handle the top corner of the case after removing all the front and side glass. The metal is weaker without the glass support. It will bend if you lift from there. Also don't use the stock fans it comes with unless you love 39 decibels as loud as a dishwasher in your ear hole.

reviews.title: Disappointed. Poor quality and design, overpriced, misleading specs
reviews.comment: Watched this item for awhile wanting to do a 420mm radiator build in a budget friendly 140mm fan case. Fans included at this size aren't common so went it went on sale from $189 to $159 figured I'd give it a try. First order arrived with fans in pieces right out of the box and the dust filters missing. Amazon support was great and sent a replacement immediately. The case itself its mediocre at best and quite frankly less so. As others have pointed out it's very cheaply made and not worth the price, even on sale. $100 +/- is the most I'd recommend after hands on with it. Cheaply built sheet metal, poorly laid out cable management, very odd placement of SSDs, the wiring in the included fans was hanging out of the daisy chain on a few connectors, the LEDs were flickering, and the includes motherboard screws were just raw in the case rattling around, to name a few issues. The glass panels don't fit toegther as nicely as they look online; personal opinion. Top issue for me is this case does not support 420mm radiators (at least not all brands) as listed. My Arctic 420mm does not fit properly on any side. Period. Its too long for the bottom and side by almost an inch. The top it almost fits but requires removing the exhaust fans; the picture shows removing one fan to do a push-pull setup, but I had to remove it for the radiator to fit at all and the holes didn't line up right to attach it to the roof. I'm not buying a new radiator to fit this case. I couldn't complete the build so there may be additional oversight in the design. Overall, it's going back. Should have bought a HAVN case to start and saved myself the time and multiple trips to UPS. Cheers to Amazon customer support once again.
